messages:
Arjun P: Quick async — anyone have visibility on H100 spot/ephemeral availability in gce-uk-west1 for the next 48h? Need to run a 2h canary for a Dedicated demo (4 GPUs). Project 'redwood-demo' hasn't had the quota bump approved yet. @Marta V can you check vendor/TAM lane or available zones?

Marta V: On it. Running a quick check — you can also try: `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=uk-west1-a,uk-west1-b` and `gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1` for quota. Will ping partner.

Benji: Quick FYI from partner portal — uk-west1-a shows 0 available H100 slots, uk-west1-b has ~4 candidate racks but needs booking (ETA ~36h). If you can accept 2xH100 in different zones we might patch it together.

infra-bot: [capacity-monitor] Alert: GCE uk-west1 H100 pool reporting low spare capacity (snapshot @2654321000). Consider fallback regions or reserved pool. Link: https://partners.redwood/capacity/uk-west1 (internal)

Kevin L: If we can't get H100 in 48h, fallback plan: run canary on eu-west1 A100 with quantized model (gpt-q4_8) and use cross-region routing for traffic split. Perf won't match exactly but should surface infra regressions. I'll open a PR to update canary config with this fallback.

TAM-Jordan: I'm looping in GCP TAM now — I'll request a temporary quota for project redwood-demo and ask partner to prioritize the uk-west1-b booking. @Arjun P please DM the project ID and the exact window you need.

Marta V: Pasted outputs from quick checks: `uk-west1-a: h100 available=0, quota=0/16`; `uk-west1-b: h100 available=4 (partner hold)`, project quota for h100: 0.

Benji: I'll ping vendor contact Maria (cc'd in partner thread) and try to secure 4 GPUs for the window. If vendor can't commit, propose Kevin's eu-west1 fallback.

Arjun P: Thanks team — plan: Benji try vendor booking now, TAM-Jordan escalate quota, Kevin open PR for fallback, Marta paste any booking confirmation here. Need final decision by +6h. :thumbsup:

Marta V: Got an initial ack from partner — tentatively reserving 4 GPUs in uk-west1-b pending PO. Sharing ETA and vendor ticket #VND-721 in 15m.

Benji: Pinged vendor; they asked for PO and ETA ~30-40h if not pre-booked. I'm pushing for a short-term borrow.

Arjun P: OK — if we don't have firm booking in 6h we'll run the eu-west1 fallback. Thanks all.
